help.mechanicalScoring: Scoring is mechanical — a finding counts when the file matches and the line ranges overlap. No model call in the scorer.
help.citationAccuracy: Citation accuracy measures whether a finding cited a line inside a real diff hunk — not whether it cited the right line.
help.provenanceChip: Severity and category come from the finding this case was seeded from. They are display-only and never affect matching.
help.deltaNeedsContext: A delta is only meaningful against the cases the two runs actually share.

compare.title: Compare runs · {a} → {b}
compare.subtitle: Old prompt vs new — metric deltas and prompt diff
compare.notComparable: Not comparable — these two runs share no case with identical inputs.
compare.notComparableHint: A case whose diff or expectation was edited is a different test. Comparing across it would compare nothing.
compare.excludedChanged: inputs changed since the earlier run
compare.excludedAdded: not present in the earlier run
compare.excludedRemoved: not present in the later run
compare.noiseFloor: Two runs of the same version can still differ — that spread is the model's own noise floor, not a regression.
compare.promptDiffEmpty: No prompt change between these runs.
compare.promptDiffUnavailable: Prompt diff unavailable — this run stored no config snapshot.
compare.skillDeltaNone: No skill change between these runs.
compare.skillDeltaUnavailable: Skill diff unavailable — this run stored no config snapshot.
compare.sameVersionDifferentConfig: Same version tag, different effective config — the linked skills changed without bumping the version. This delta is NOT model noise.
compare.promoteUnavailable: This run stored no config snapshot, so it cannot be promoted.
compare.promoteSkillMoved: A pinned skill's body has changed since this run. Promoting restores the skill links, not the skill text — the agent will not be byte-identical to the one this run measured.
